metadata.title: Light Below
metadata.description: Survey an Ocean Monument and recover luminous prismarine.

offer.label: Light Below
lines: There is a Monument offshore that shines where no village road can reach.
Mark its position and bring back the bright glass the guardians keep below.
Survey the marked Ocean Monument, then bring 12 prismarine crystals and 1 sea lantern. I will make the reward worth the trouble.

turn_in.label: About Light Below
lines: Cold light from deep water. The cartography table has never looked brighter.
The sea kept its Monument, but we have its bearing and a piece of its light.
Let me see the full work before I close the note.
